expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (4 users migrated with trimmed names)
The final message accounts for all 5 source users: 4 migrated and user 3 not migrated because it has no email
expectations.evidence: The final message says "It migrated 4 of the 5 users; one user (uid 3, Cy Ode) has no email and was left out."

expectations.text: The script or its output compares source and target counts (or lists skipped items with a reason) rather than silently dropping the record
expectations.evidence: The script logs `Migrated ${migrated.length} of ${users.length} users` and warns `Skipped ${skipped.length} user(s) with no email: uid ...`, then sets process.exitCode = 1.
